authority: User explicitly authorized freeze and run in this chat
exposure: All manuscript material exposed/uncertified; prior outcomes and qualification results known. Neither prospective confirmation nor independent replication.
scope: Re-adjudicate unchanged v3.1 A-P1/A-bath/A-starred and B-Q1 under the completed frozen qualification follow-up. Preserve v3.1 and qualification artifacts. No new controls, folios, context pooling, glyph handling, semantic inference or heterogeneity scoring.

qualification_link.eligibility: Use only each exact matching cell-reading classified QUALIFIED by the fixed follow-up, with support still passing. Do not pool old200 and fresh controls or combine H/F. No new gates or interpretation of absence of nominal alarms as proof of exact calibration.
qualification_link.limits: Qualification applies to frozen geometry and authored generators. B-Q1 remains the unconditioned aggregate contrast; ordinary inherited synthetic generators can assign qok outcomes to blocked followers. Part A availability-only has the same marginal law as low-null after filtering.

events: Reconstruct y from preserved EVENTS.csv for the exact existing MASKED-v3.1.json events, keyed reading/line/position. Require one-to-one eligible-event coverage, unchanged origin/family/available flag and frozen support for every cell. Do not open raw EVT or reserved zodiac material.
engine: Call unchanged attempt C exact one-sided sh>ch engine, folio x ending family. A uses available-only origins. B-Q1 uses C6+C7 all eligible origins. Degenerate exact distribution => NOT ESTIMABLE, p=null.
effect: Same MH risk difference and4999 percentile folio-bootstrap CIs as v3.1; fixed original seed7100000+index in cell_order. Require exact replay of saved estimates. Descriptive context map, aggregate estimates, strict sensitivity and paired surviving-share estimates are carried forward unchanged and retain their descriptive status.
support: Unchanged V>=80, >=8 supported pages, maximum page share<=.25. Replay against frozen v3.1 support.

multiplicity.rule: Original Holm3 A and Holm2 B separately for each reading. Unsupported, blocked or degenerate slots occupy internal p=1 without dropping the slot and display no inferential p. Thus B-Q1 retains its factor2 while B-Q2 remains blocked. Recompute Holm for every A family rather than retaining old adjusted p-values.

headline: PASS iff qualified, support-passing, nondegenerate, positive effect and Holm-adjusted p<=.05. NO PASS otherwise when scoreable. Both H/F must PASS for a cross-reading A-cell headline; H/F are alternate readings, not independent replications.
BQ2: UNQUALIFIED throughout. No new permutation, REML or inferential heterogeneity calculation. Internal Holm slot p=1; displayed inferential raw/adjusted p=null. Existing context estimates and heterogeneity summaries remain descriptive/unqualified. Leave both scribe2 sensitivities unqualified.
verification: Independent combinatorial p-value oracle for each scored cell; independent direct MH calculation from event outcomes; independent Holm formula; one-to-one event reconciliation; exact old effect/CI/support replay; original39 hashes and all frozen qualification artifact hashes before and after.
preservation: Write only this new directory. Original v3.1 files/statuses remain unchanged. New results are explicitly labeled separate retrospective re-adjudication; neither rewrite nor promotion inside original artifacts.
